title: Six-year-old gateway with three generations of error handling
notes: Deliberately inconsistent, the way real legacy code is. Three error envelopes coexist, /v1/charge returns 200 with an error body, /v1/users returns 200 with {} for a missing user while /v2 returns 404, and two endpoints return non-object JSON. Every one of those is a thing a rewrite normalises and a client depends on.
